title: rehan-remade/universal-modder
why_read: An ambitious project letting an AI agent reverse-engineer and mod arbitrary PC games using generative art/3D/audio tools, interesting as an applied agentic AI use case.
analysis: This project equips Claude Code with specialized skills and tools, including an MCP integration with a generative media service, to let it analyze a game's files, reverse engineer assets, and inject AI-generated art, 3D models, or audio as mods. It's a creative and technically nontrivial application of LLM agents combined with reverse engineering and generative content pipelines. The approach raises interesting questions about automated game modding workflows and the robustness of letting an agent poke at arbitrary binary game files. It sits in a legal gray area around modifying commercial game assets, though modding itself is broadly accepted in gaming communities.
